title: 2027 Home & Outdoor Living Show of Greater Springfield
seo_title: 2027 Home & Outdoor Living Show in Springfield, MO
description: This annual home and outdoor living show lets visitors meet local builders, remodelers, designers, landscapers and other home industry experts face-to-face, explore products and services, and get advice during Shop Talks. It suits anyone planning a remodel, a new home or an outdoor refresh, and families are welcome; children under 12 and veterans are admitted free, and parking is free. It runs Friday, January 8, 2027 at 10:00 AM through Sunday, January 10 at 4:00 PM at Wilson Logistics Arena, 3001 N Grant Ave in Springfield, MO.
